# CAM_UV_robotics -- Final Results

**TS-CAM-UV** on **Robotics (Pepper)**. Generated by `tools/write_final_results.py` from this folder's `outputs/`; every figure below is read from the files the run wrote, never transcribed.


## Detection performance

The threshold is the 95th percentile of the fault-free score distribution, computed without reference to any attack label. AUC-ROC is the primary metric because it is threshold-free; F1 is reported at that fixed operating point and is only comparable against other rows measured the same way.

| Variant | TP | FP | TN | FN | Precision | Recall | F1 | AUC-ROC | AUC-PR |
| :--- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Linear / Ridge | 267 | 28 | 520 | 563 | 0.9051 | 0.3217 | **0.4747** | **0.6497** | 0.7989 |
| Polynomial degree 3 | 328 | 28 | 520 | 502 | 0.9213 | 0.3952 | **0.5531** | **0.6888** | 0.8205 |
| RBF + Ridge | 565 | 28 | 520 | 265 | 0.9528 | 0.6807 | **0.7941** | **0.7818** | 0.8909 |

Best by AUC-ROC: **RBF + Ridge** at **0.7818**, over 1378 evaluated samples.

| `CAUSAL_STRENGTH_MULTIPLIER` | 1.0 |

| `RIDGE_ALPHA` | 10.0 |
| `SUBSAMPLE_EXPECTED` | 10 |
| `THRESHOLD_PERCENTILE` | 95.0 |

These values match the other two algorithms on this dataset. Only the causal discovery method and the regression type differ across folders; see the root `README.md` section 6.

### XAI course lab check

- LED attacks rank `TabletTouchX` first in **3 of 3** variants.
- Joint attacks rank `KneePicthTemp` first in **3 of 3** variants.

Feature selection is name-agnostic: the highest-variance channels measured at full temporal resolution on the training split. No sensor is selected by name, so these attributions are discovered by the model rather than imposed by the pipeline.


## Reproducing

```bash
cd CAM-UV/CAM_UV_robotics
python anomaly_detection.py
python anomaly_detection_polynomial.py
python anomaly_detection_rbf.py
```

The first run learns and caches the causal graph; later runs reuse it. Delete the `.npz` cache to force rediscovery. The scripts refuse to run against a cache whose resampling rate disagrees with the code, so a stale cache fails loudly instead of reporting metrics for a pipeline that no longer exists.
